authority_note: External sources are dated advisory comparisons only and never Maple Moon authority.

sources.title: Boss design-system gap audit packet
sources.observation: Defines exact authority, inputs, outputs, controls and no-implementation boundary.
sources.conflict_or_fit: Highest scope authority for this work.

sources.title: Current Boss execution ledger
sources.observation: Current decisions include D01–D06, shared mobile chrome, Home exception, Etheryx/OS2.0 and all 24 products.
sources.conflict_or_fit: Supersedes stale six-bar/implementation assumptions only where explicit.

sources.title: Accepted sealed v0.3.1 Styles Kit
sources.owner: Maple Moon Styles Kit task; accepted by Boss
sources.observation: 68 rules, 12 decisions and 70 tokens with mixed statuses.
sources.applicability: Planning authority only; never implementation proof.
sources.conflict_or_fit: Statuses preserved.

sources.title: Luxury polish research overlay v0.3.2
sources.observation: Advisory restraint, hierarchy, pacing and media principles.
sources.conflict_or_fit: No status promotion.

sources.title: v0.4 planning visual guidance
sources.observation: Four specimen families at four widths.
sources.conflict_or_fit: No specimen is website approval.

sources.title: Boss-pinned m49 candidate and exact local bytes
sources.observation: Authenticated IAB inspection plus 28 local hash-pinned fresh contexts.
sources.conflict_or_fit: Implementation evidence, never rule authority.

sources.title: Web Content Accessibility Guidelines 2.2
sources.observation: Defines reflow, focus, target size and other conformance criteria.
sources.conflict_or_fit: Fits Maple Moon guardrails; not visual authority.

sources.title: Understanding Reflow
sources.observation: Reflow and 200% text/zoom must avoid two-dimensional reading; sticky content must not obscure focus.
sources.conflict_or_fit: Fits.

sources.title: ARIA Authoring Practices patterns
sources.observation: Documents keyboard and semantic contracts for accordion, disclosure, dialog and menu button patterns.
sources.conflict_or_fit: Fits; native HTML remains preferred where possible.

sources.title: Accessibility best practices for Shopify themes
sources.observation: Requires keyboard operation, visible focus, skip link, labelled forms, dialog focus management and 44×44 primary targets.
sources.conflict_or_fit: Fits Maple Moon’s 44px rule.

sources.title: Performance best practices for Shopify themes
sources.observation: Prefer HTML/CSS, responsive image_tag output, restrained preloads and below-fold lazy loading.
sources.applicability: Media delivery and later Etheryx implementation.
sources.conflict_or_fit: Fits; no implementation imported.

sources.title: Building with sections and blocks
sources.observation: Sections/blocks should remain reorderable and flow logically regardless of block sequence.
sources.conflict_or_fit: Fits; design guardrails must constrain unsafe combinations.

sources.title: Online Store 2.0
sources.observation: JSON templates, dynamic sources and app blocks enable modular merchant editing.
sources.conflict_or_fit: Fits current Boss decision.

sources.title: JSON templates
sources.observation: A JSON template supports up to 25 sections and each section up to 50 blocks.
sources.conflict_or_fit: Constraints must be discovered in Etheryx before mapping.

sources.title: Preload responsive images
sources.observation: srcset/sizes let the browser choose an appropriately sized resource; critical images may need carefully targeted preload/fetch priority.
sources.conflict_or_fit: Fits MEDIA-005.

sources.title: Optimize Cumulative Layout Shift
sources.observation: Unreserved lazy media can shift content; intrinsic geometry reduces CLS.
sources.conflict_or_fit: Fits.

sources.title: Human Interface Guidelines — Typography
sources.observation: Use a limited type set, preserve hierarchy and adapt to larger text without truncation.
sources.applicability: Advisory for legibility and fallback testing.
sources.conflict_or_fit: Fits; platform styling is not imported.

sources.title: Human Interface Guidelines — Motion
sources.observation: Motion should be purposeful, brief, optional and cancelable.
sources.conflict_or_fit: Fits quiet premium direction.

sources.title: Porsche Design System v3 — Spacing
sources.observation: Separates fluid and static spacing scales in a documented system.
sources.applicability: Reference for disciplined token use only.
sources.conflict_or_fit: Fits methodology; values/components are not imported.

sources.title: Aesop official site
sources.observation: Combines narrative modules, product discovery and truthful service capability.
sources.conflict_or_fit: Fit: truthful service and varied pacing. Conflict: dense catalogue/navigation must not be copied.

sources.title: LOEWE official site
sources.observation: Inserts editorial chapters inside product discovery rather than treating every module equally.
sources.conflict_or_fit: Fit: asymmetric editorial/product pacing. Conflict: fashion-scale imagery and oversized branding.

sources.title: The Row official site
sources.observation: Shows extreme editing, low chrome and image-first hierarchy.
sources.conflict_or_fit: Fit: fewer modules. Conflict: small utility type and image-dependent emptiness fail Maple Moon needs.

sources.title: Hermès official online store
sources.observation: Uses distinct story-to-product chapters with focused actions.
sources.conflict_or_fit: Fit: chapter variation. Conflict: campaign theatre and luxury copy are not Maple Moon authority.
